sn42.6:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
sn42.6:1.2: atha kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.6:2.1: brāhmaṇā bhante pacchābhūmakā kāmaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā udakorohakā aggiparicārakā
sn42.6:2.2: te mataṃ kālakataṃ uyyāpenti nāma saññāpenti nāma saggaṃ nāma okkāpenti.
sn42.6:2.3: bhagavā pana bhante arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pahoti tathā kātuṃ yathā sabbo loko kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyāti.
sn42.6:3.1: tenahi gāmaṇi taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsīti.
sn42.6:4.2: idhassa puriso pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesu micchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko
sn42.6:4.3: tamenaṃ mahājanakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya
sn42.6:4.4: ayaṃ puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatūti.
sn42.6:4.6: api nu so puriso mahato janakāyassa āyācanahetu vā thomanahetu vā pañjalikāanuparisakkanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyāti.
sn42.6:5.1: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi puriso mahantaṃ puthusilaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya
sn42.6:5.2: tamenaṃ mahājanakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya
sn42.6:5.3: ummujja bho puthusile uplava bho puthusile thalamuplava bho puthusileti.
sn42.6:5.5: api nu sā puthusilā mahato janakāyassa āyācanahetu vā thomanahetu vā pañjalikāanuparisakkanahetu vā ummujjeyya vā uplaveyya vā thalaṃ vā uplaveyyāti.
sn42.6:5.7: evameva kho gāmaṇi yo so puriso pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesu micchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko.
sn42.6:5.8: kiñcāpi taṃ mahājanakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya
sn42.6:5.9: ayaṃ puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatūti. atha kho so puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyya.
sn42.6:6.2: idhassa puriso pāṇātipātā paṭivirato adinnādānā paṭivirato kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato musāvādā paṭivirato pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato samphappalāpā paṭivirato anabhijjhālu abyāpannacitto sammādiṭṭhiko
sn42.6:6.3: tamenaṃ mahājanakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya
sn42.6:6.4: ayaṃ puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatūti.
sn42.6:6.6: api nu so puriso mahato janakāyassa āyācanahetu vā thomanahetu vā pañjalikāanuparisakkanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyāti.
sn42.6:7.1: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi puriso sappikumbhaṃ vā telakumbhaṃ vā gambhīraṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhitvā bhindeyya tatra yassa sakkharā vā kaṭhalā vā sā adhogāmī assa yañca khvassa tatra sappi vā telaṃ vā taṃ uddhaṅgāmi assa
sn42.6:7.2: tamenaṃ mahājanakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya
sn42.6:7.3: osīda bho sappitela saṃsīda bho sappitela adho gaccha bho sappitelāti.
sn42.6:7.5: api nu taṃ sappitelaṃ mahato janakāyassa āyācanahetu vā thomanahetu vā pañjalikāanuparisakkanahetu vā osīdeyya vā saṃsīdeyya vā adho vā gaccheyyāti.
sn42.6:8.1: evameva kho gāmaṇi yo so puriso pāṇātipātā paṭivirato adinnādānā paṭivirato kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato musāvādā paṭivirato pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato samphappalāpā paṭivirato anabhijjhālu abyāpannacitto sammādiṭṭhiko
sn42.6:8.2: kiñcāpi taṃ mahājanakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya
sn42.6:8.3: ayaṃ puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatūti. atha kho so puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyāti.
sn42.6:8.4: evaṃ vutte asibandhakaputto gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
